name: Ortolan
description: Ortolans were a race of stocky, bipeds with long snouts, and large floppy ears. Ortolans came from the frigid, mineral-rich planet Orto. Two of the most famous Ortolans were the Jedi Knight Nem Bees and the musician Max Rebo.

data.name: Ortolan
data.skincolor: Covered in short fur in various colors
data.distinctions: Stocky builds, trunklike noses, floppy ears, small mouths
